report_name: CISA Publishes New Logging Reference Architecture for Federal Agencies

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
identities.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) released the Logging Reference Architecture (LRA) to guide federal agencies in modernizing their log management capabilities.

identities.name: Office of Management and Budget
identities.description: The U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) issued Memorandum M-26-14, which mandated the logging enhancements that CISA's Logging Reference Architecture (LRA) is designed to implement. OMB enforces compliance for FCEB agencies.

identities.name: Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies
identities.description: A class of U.S. federal agencies for which the Logging Reference Architecture (LRA) is a mandatory implementation guide for log management.

identities.name: State, Local, Tribal, and Territorial (SLTT) governments
identities.description: A class of government entities that CISA encourages to adopt the principles of the Logging Reference Architecture (LRA).

identities.name: Critical infrastructure operators
identities.description: A class of organizations that CISA encourages to adopt the principles of the Logging Reference Architecture (LRA).

identities.name: Private sector companies
identities.description: A class of organizations that CISA encourages to adopt the principles of the Logging Reference Architecture (LRA).
